summary_md: **Gaël Caporale ([@Gael_DDOS](https://x.com/Gael_DDOS/status/2115446116804116846))** summarizes a r/LocalLLaMA comparison of six inference engines running **Qwen3.8 27B on one RTX 5090**: llama.cpp 84.2 tok/s, TensorSharp 80.0, SGLang 78.5, vLLM 247.8 with speculative decoding, and NInfer 280.5 with DFlash2 (488 aggregate at 4 concurrent). He warns that quant and drafter differ per engine, so it is "a map not a race".

referenced_urls.title: From the LocalLLaMA community on Reddit: Qwen3.8 27B on one RTX 5090: six inference engines benchmarked with and without DFlash2

relevance: Engine-by-engine throughput for the ~30B reasoning tier on a single consumer GPU, with speculative decoding as the big lever.
